message.content: {"note_claim": "The new Lord Mayor of Leicester, Kulwinder Singh Johal, is Sikh and not Muslim.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Guided by his Sikh faith and the principle of seva (selfless service), he has volunteered for decades and is committed to serving every resident of Leicester with openness, respect and humility.", "reason": "The official Leicester City Council page names Kulwinder Singh Johal as Lord Mayor for 2026-27 and states he is guided by his Sikh faith."}

parsed.note_claim: The new Lord Mayor of Leicester, Kulwinder Singh Johal, is Sikh and not Muslim.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Guided by his Sikh faith and the principle of seva (selfless service), he has volunteered for decades and is committed to serving every resident of Leicester with openness, respect and humility.
parsed.reason: The official Leicester City Council page names Kulwinder Singh Johal as Lord Mayor for 2026-27 and states he is guided by his Sikh faith.
